$:set -e
name=$(gh codespace list --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --json name,repository --jq '.[]|select(.repository=="BestNameYet/Terminals")|.name' | head -n 1)
gh codespace ssh -c "$name" -- "bash -lc 'if [[ -n \u0024{MCP_GH_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET:-} ]]; then echo login_shell_secret=present; else echo login_shell_secret=missing; fi; if [[ -n \u0024{CODESPACE_NAME:-} ]]; then echo login_shell_name=present; else echo login_shell_name=missing; fi'"
printf '\nRepository Codespaces secret names:\n'
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/codespaces/secrets --jq '.secrets[].name' || true
